name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 33 - Am 20
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 33. Considers that, while the Agreement may signal support for open and rules-based trade, the economic case for this Agreement remains weak; notes that the Commission’s own assessments of the existing agreement point to limited economic benefits and limited evidence of job creation and export diversification;
